message.content:
In a standard Texas Hold’em hand a player can hold at most **seven hearts** (the two hole cards plus the five community cards).  
So the “player with the highest number of hearts” is simply the one who manages to get all seven hearts in his/her 7‑card hand.  

(If you’re playing a different variant—e.g., Omaha, where you get four hole cards plus five community cards—a player could hold up to **nine hearts**.)
